SELECT
    t.SEC_SNAME AS `股票名称`,
    t.STOCKCODE AS `股票代码`,
    DATE_FORMAT(MIN(t.TRD_DATE), '%Y-%m-%d') AS `8月首个交易日`,
    DATE_FORMAT(MAX(t.TRD_DATE), '%Y-%m-%d') AS `8月最后交易日`,
    ROUND(MIN(t.TCAP_1)/100000000, 1) AS `8月初总市值(亿)`,
    ROUND(MAX(t.TCAP_1)/100000000, 1) AS `8月末总市值(亿)`,
    ROUND(MIN(t.TCAP_2)/100000000, 1) AS `8月初流通市值(亿)`,
    ROUND(MAX(t.TCAP_2)/100000000, 1) AS `8月末流通市值(亿)`,
    ROUND((MAX(t.TCAP_1) - MIN(t.TCAP_1)) / NULLIF(MIN(t.TCAP_1),0) * 100, 2) AS `8月总市值变动率(%)`,
    ROUND((MAX(t.TCAP_2) - MIN(t.TCAP_2)) / NULLIF(MIN(t.TCAP_2),0) * 100, 2) AS `8月流通市值变动率(%)`
FROM
    ANA_STK_VAL_IDX t
WHERE
    t.SEC_SNAME LIKE '%格力电器%'
    AND t.ISVALID = 1
    AND t.TRD_DATE >= '2026-08-01'
    AND t.TRD_DATE <= '2026-08-31'
    AND t.TCAP_1 IS NOT NULL
    AND t.TCAP_2 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    t.SEC_SNAME,
    t.STOCKCODE
